verdict.rationale: Gumloop's docs say a webhook trigger gives an agent its own unique URL. Any HTTP POST to that URL, from Stripe, GitHub, a cron job or an internal script, runs the agent, and fires when another app sends data, with no API key or SDK needed. This covers exposing a URL that starts a run from external requests. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the incoming payload is parsed or mapped into the run, details on securing or verifying the webhook, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
